intro.subtitle: 拑牢牢！出發啦！
intro.text:
[VOICE CHARACTER: A 55-year-old male Taiwanese night-market rodeo-game stall owner, calling loudly across a busy outdoor stall. Very low, thick, coarse, gravelly baritone; audible raspy vocal edge, chest resonance and a big diaphragm-supported projection. Rough everyday street delivery, relaxed local swagger, cheeky and friendly. LANGUAGE: Native Taiwan Taiwanese Hokkien / Tai-gi, colloquial southern Taiwan rhythm, natural tone sandhi. Read the Tai-lo romanized script as spoken Taiwanese, never as English syllables. PERFORMANCE: Speak to a player standing at your stall, with punchy consonants and broad, earthy intonation. Maintain the same hefty older male character, even while teasing. Dry solo speech, no background crowd, no music, no added words, do not read instructions. A rough energetic invitation, punchy chest voice. 1.5 to 2 seconds.]
Khînn-tiâu-tiâu! Tshut-huat--lah!
